security_audit.summary: The skill performs legitimate visual QA with Playwright, but it has real network navigation and filesystem write behavior. Most static command and hidden-file findings are Markdown documentation false positives. Additional review should focus on broad tool permissions and default output paths outside the workspace.

remediation.suggestion: Require users to provide the target base URL, or clearly label default domains before running the workflow.

remediation.issue: Filesystem writes to broad output paths
remediation.suggestion: Default screenshots to a workspace-relative directory and validate user-provided output paths before creating directories.
Remove Write and Edit unless the skill truly modifies project files, and document why Task is needed.
Use relative skill paths or installation placeholders instead of /root/.claude examples.

content.user_title: Review Responsive Pages With Visual QA
content.value_statement: Responsive websites can hide layout defects after animation changes. This skill captures scrolled full-page screenshots across device sizes for focused visual review.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Playwright-based screenshot script for one URL or predefined site pages.
Scrolls each page before capture to trigger GSAP and ScrollTrigger animations.
Captures full-page PNG screenshots across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes.
Saves timestamped files to a local output directory.
Provides a manual checklist for reviewing headers, content, forms, and responsive layouts.
limitations: Requires Python, Playwright, and Chromium to be installed before use.
Defaults target a specific development site unless the user supplies another URL or base URL.
Does not compare screenshots against baselines or produce automated visual diffs.
Writes screenshots to the local filesystem and needs a trusted output path.

use_cases.title: Validate responsive layout changes
use_cases.description: Capture screenshots for key pages and review animation, spacing, and overflow issues.

use_cases.title: Review animated pages across devices
use_cases.description: Generate consistent full-page captures to compare visual treatment on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

use_cases.title: Collect release evidence
use_cases.description: Create timestamped screenshots of important pages before a release or client review.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Run visual QA for this URL: {url}. Capture desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots, then summarize visible layout issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review Configured Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Run visual QA on all configured pages for {base_url}. Note layout, image, form, and navigation issues by device size.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Animation Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check {url} after animation updates. Scroll before capture, then identify elements that remain hidden, cropped, or misaligned.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Release QA Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full visual QA pass for {base_url}. Group findings by severity and list screenshots that need human review.

output_examples.input: Run visual QA on the About page after the hero update.
output_examples.output: Screenshots were captured across device sizes. The review found a desktop hero alignment issue and mobile spacing below the bio section.

output_examples.input: Check all configured pages before release.
output: Portfolio needs review because two images appear repeated.
Contact and legal pages show no major layout issues.

best_practices: Run the skill after layout, animation, template, or image changes.
Use a workspace-relative output directory for each review.
Review screenshots with the project requirements beside the checklist.
anti_patterns: Running the default site targets when reviewing an unrelated project.
Treating screenshots as a replacement for accessibility or interaction testing.
Saving output into shared system directories or sensitive user folders.

faq.question: What does this skill test?
faq.answer: It captures responsive screenshots and supports manual review of layout, images, forms, navigation, and animation states.

faq.question: Does it support custom URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The screenshot script accepts a single URL and also supports a base URL for configured page paths.

faq.question: Does it run visual diffs?
faq.answer: No. It captures screenshots for review but does not compare them against a stored baseline.

faq.question: Why does it scroll before screenshots?
faq.answer: Scrolling helps trigger GSAP and ScrollTrigger animations before full-page screenshots are captured.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The local environment needs Python, Playwright, and a Chromium browser installation.

faq.question: Where are screenshots saved?
faq.answer: Screenshots are saved to a local output directory. Use a workspace-relative path for safer review workflows.
